title: Bourbon Signal
shortDescription: Find local bourbon reports and get alerts for bottles you follow.
fullDescription:
See recent bourbon reports where you shop. Follow the bottles you want and check the price before making a trip.

Start free. Browse the signal preview and community sightings, save a bottle in Radar, use Bottle Check, and keep a small My Shelf collection.

Barrel Proof is the optional monthly membership. Set alerts for the bottles and areas you choose, browse the full feed, and unlock unlimited Bottle Checks and shelf space. Existing members can sign in to keep their access.

Coverage varies by market and source. Reports are timestamped and availability changes. Confirm with the retailer before traveling. For adults age 21 and older.

Barrel Proof renews monthly unless canceled. See current pricing before buying and manage your subscription through Google Play. Existing memberships are managed through the provider used to purchase.
